title: HR University – University Website & Portal
oneLiner: An interactive university web portal and modular Django 5 REST backend managing academic departments, admission workflows, and campus events.
note: Frontend developed with interactive animations; Django 5 modular backend in active development.
description: Architecting and building a modern institutional web portal for university admissions, department directories, campus events, and student enquiry management.
Engineered the frontend experience with an animated introductory sequence, live institutional statistics counters, hero video integration, and responsive modal enquiry workflows.
Constructed the backend in Django 5 with Django REST Framework, cleanly structured into 11 decoupled apps, 32 relational models, and 38 REST endpoints.

items: Animated page transitions and live institutional statistics counter displays.
Interactive admissions enquiry popup with client-side field validation.
Mobile-first navigation across faculties, research centers, and campus event feeds.
11 decoupled Django applications isolating admissions, faculty, placements, and news.
38 RESTful API endpoints with structured serializers and OpenAPI documentation.
Comprehensive Django admin permission scoping for non-technical administrative staff.

challenges.title: Decoupled Relational Schema for 11 University Domains
challenges.body: Orchestrating admissions, courses, faculty, and events without circular foreign key dependencies. Solved using clean domain-driven application boundaries and abstract base models.

challenges.title: Maintaining High Core Web Vitals with Rich Media
challenges.body: Optimized animated introductory sequences and video media with lazy rendering and hardware-accelerated CSS transforms to guarantee sub-2.5s LCP.
